positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developing for SAP HANA in-memory database.
Developed Hadoop support
- Access to pig, hive and direct HDFS from the SAP Data Services EIM product
- Implemented text analysis within the Hadoop map-reduce framework
Primary architect for a redesign of text analysis SDK.
- Developed uniform API for multiple text analysis products
- Developed user extensible document annotation format
- Worked with small group on enhanced aliasing techniques (Patent: US8312018)
Enhanced document categorizer tool
- Utilized text analysis algorithms built on Xerox FST technology
- Implemented machine learning algorithm for automatic taxonomy generation
Made enhancements to internal search engine code

positions.title: Manager of Software Development
positions.description:
Developed enhancements for next generation product using VC++.
 -COM based UI developments.
 -Machine language parsers/translators (lex/yacc and hand generated top/down).
 -Created a UMESS/UX to DMIS converter.
Managed San Jose office and development team.
Managed complete software life cycle for legacy product.
Managed company computers and network (firewall, email, web server).

positions.title: Manager of Software Development
positions.description:
Developed code in C/C++ on Unix and WIndows.
 -Created a web collaboration tool.
 -Created a multi-threaded interface to connect directly to the Adept robot controller using TCP/IP and UDP.
 -Created a COM interface to 3rd party robot path planner.
Created a Java based interactive help system between product and browser.
Managed a team of developers working on next generation factory automation suite.

positions.title: Supervisor, Platform Technology
positions.description:
Developed code in C/C++ on Unix and Windows.
 -Created a CAD converter server that clients connected to via TCP/IP.
 -Created a CAD converter batch interface.
 -Generated multimedia output in the form of AVI, MPEG, TIFF, and JPEG.
Managed the Operations Group which maintained the company network and handled product builds and shipments.

positions.title: Project Lead
positions.description:
Created a multi-platform UI that ran under Unix (Motif) and Windows (MFC).
Created a 3D movie play back interface.
Created a multimedia slide show program for Unix platforms.
Created a TCP/IP interface connecting to 3rd party robot path planners.

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description:
Developed custom database and bug tracking system.
Maintained internal network of 30+ Unix machines.
